latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Subtitle Generator Free.

- Generate and burn in AI-powered subtitles for video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Quick cloud-based processing (30–60 seconds for short clips), results delivered as 1080p MP4 files.
- Free to use with optional anonymous token (100 credits for 7 days); supports YouTubers and content creators.
- Easy workflows: upload video, describe the edit/subtitles you want, download your captioned video.
- Error handling and progress updates streamlined for smooth user experience.
